utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Rey, I’ve heard it may be Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community center with no sign-up, but I’d rather confirm with Tess before we send everyone over with broken things.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds wise, Pia. I’ll hold off telling anyone until Tess confirms, and I can check with Mina about the tools so we don’t duplicate what Gus is bringing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey—that would help a lot; if Tess confirms the time and Mina knows the tool plan, then I’ll feel better about passing it along.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Quinn, I’m still waiting on the organizers to confirm the date, repair list, and whether the time window is still around 3:30 to 6, but I’m checking today and I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Tess—I’d heard Saturday 10 to 2 at the community center as a drop-in, but if you’re confirming a different window, please let me know right away so I can update everyone I’ve told.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks Quinn — I’ll flag that with the organizers when I check today, and I’ll let you know right away whether it’s Saturday 10 to 2 or that 3:30 to 6 window so nobody gets crossed up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Jules—I’m still catching up, but Quinn told me the repair drive is Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community center, drop-in, no sign-up needed. Rosa’s also gathering repair requests this week so they can match volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Nell — I may have a different time on my end, since I’ve been planning for 3:30 to 6 with Faye helping until about 5:30. I’ll check with Quinn and Rosa so we don’t send folks mixed details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Jules—please let me know what Quinn and Rosa confirm, and I’ll hold off spreading the exact time until we’re sure.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Dane, quick update on the repair drive: we’re still gathering what needs fixing and who can bring tools, so let me know if you’ve heard anything newer.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — last I heard from Cleo, the first push is the shed roof and some porch rails, and I’m still likely coming a bit late. When I get there I’ll check by the shed and jump into tool sorting or hauling, whichever is backed up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Dane—I’ll pass along that the shed roof and porch rails are the first priorities, and that you’ll come late and check by the shed for sorting or hauling.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Bo, before I add anything to the repair drive list, can you tell me what needs fixing, where it is, how urgent it feels, and whether anyone has already offered supplies or help?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m slammed and haven’t checked yet, Hana — I only told Opal I’d look at the garage and side shed later, then ping her and Rosa before anything gets marked confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Bo — I’ll leave the garage and side shed unconfirmed for now, and note that you’ll check them later and ping Opal and Rosa before we mark anything.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Kira! Quick update: the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and this week we’re collecting repair requests so I can match them with volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Rosa—can you confirm who gave you the Sunday update, and what kinds of repairs you’re matching volunteers for?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: The Sunday move came through the drive planning update I’m working from, and for repairs we’re matching basics like small household fixes, mending, tool sharpening, and simple bike or appliance troubleshooting.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sam, I’ve got us set for Saturday the 15th at nine, with my folding table, hand tools, extension cord, and two labeled bins confirmed. Let’s keep the plan simple: tools, snacks, sign-ups, and drop-off spots.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, Eli—I’ll be there Saturday at nine and can cover snacks plus help with sign-ups and drop-off spots.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Sam—thank you; I’ll put you down for snacks, sign-ups, and helping check the drop-off spots, and we’ll keep everything on the checklist.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Mina, I’m planning around school pickup, so a 3:30 to 6 window would work well for me—I can come right after pickup to help set up and stay until about 5:30.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That works, Faye—can you handle setup from 3:30 and then cover the sign-in table until 5:30, or do you need a lighter task?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can handle setup at 3:30 and cover the sign-in table until 5:30; that fits well after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Opal, I think Eli settled us on Saturday the 15th at nine, and she’s starting a checklist for tools, snacks, and sign-ups—though I’d better double-check the final repair list and drop-off spot with Eli or Leo before I muddle it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Oren — I’ll keep Saturday the 15th at nine marked as confirmed from Eli, and I’ll leave the final repair list and drop-off spot pending until you’ve checked with Eli or Leo.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’s perfect, Opal—thank you, and please remind me if I wander off before I check with Eli or Leo about that repair list and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hi Noah—have you heard the confirmed repair list and drop-off spot from Eli or Leo? I promised Leo I wouldn’t pass along guesses.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Ira—I haven’t heard a confirmed list or drop-off spot yet, so I wouldn’t want to guess either. If Eli or Leo sends me the real update, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Noah—I’ll keep checking on my errands and won’t tell Leo anything until Eli or Leo confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mara, I’m keeping the supply list by the shed, and we’re starting with roof patching gear and rail repair materials first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll note that the supply list is by the shed, with roof patching gear and rail repair materials as the first priorities.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Mara—if anyone brings extra tarps, nails, brackets, or sturdy lumber, send them my way so I can mark it down before it gets used.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Leo, I’ve already got two toolboxes, the spare drill, a full bit set, and a heavy-duty extension cord covered for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks Gus. Hold onto them for now—I’m still waiting on Ira for the confirmed repair list and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Leo—I’ll keep everything set aside and wait for the confirmed list and drop-off spot before hauling it over.
